title: feat: accept large inline PDF and Inkling audio chat input
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Accepts unchanged large PDF `file_data` requests on OpenRouter models by storing PDFs in media and forwarding `file_url`.
- Accepts unchanged large base64 `input_audio.data` requests on `thinkingmachines/inkling` by forwarding the media URL through its Fireworks transform.
- Keeps the 100 MiB request, 20 MiB per-item, and 16 MiB compact-body limits, with account-scoped content hashes for upload reuse.
- Adds route tests for requests above 32 MiB, passes focused tests and typecheck, and deploys Gen staging from this branch. An authenticated staging provider call still needs a valid key.

Addresses #15889. Follow-up to #16267.

gist.headline: Big files, small detour
gist.blurb: Large PDFs and audio clips get a quiet trip through media storage on their way to chat. The request can stay exactly as it is.
gist.summary: Gen accepts large inline PDF file_data for OpenRouter models and base64 input_audio.data for thinkingmachines/inkling by storing the media and forwarding a URL, while retaining the 100 MiB request, 20 MiB per-item, and 16 MiB compact-body limits.
gist.impact: Developers can send those large PDF and Inkling audio requests unchanged, with account-scoped content hashes allowing uploaded media to be reused.
gist.visual_concept: Pollinations' bee helps a chunky CRT robot pass an oversized PDF and an audio cassette through a friendly media-storage waystation toward two chat terminals labeled OpenRouter and Inkling. A small code-plant grows beside the route; the URL handoff is depicted as a neat little parcel rather than a wall of base64.
